Zhuyin, one sound at a time
In Taiwan, Zhuyin (Bopomofo) comes before characters. If Mandarin is spoken at home here in Australia and you'd like the little ones to pick up the sounds too, I built Lumi Bopomofo for that.
• Hear a sound, then feed the matching symbol to a space friend
• Trace each symbol
• Blend symbols into a syllable on the Sound Train
• Hear the tones on the Tone Coaster
No ads, and it runs offline, so it's handy in the car or at the grandparents'. Start with ㄅ straight away; the other 36 symbols and the rest of the levels unlock with an in-app purchase.

See the trend, not the daily noise. I'm the developer of Kumo. It keeps the daily weigh-in to about 10 seconds: it opens on today with your last weight already filled in, you adjust by 0.1, and you're done. Each reading shows up as a daily dot alongside a 7-day average line, so you follow the trend instead of every jump. A cute cloud grows with the days you log, not with your weight. No account and no ads. Kumo is for personal tracking only and doesn't give medical advice.

Wi-Fi says connected, but nothing loads? One tap in WiFi Aid Lite checks Wi-Fi, DNS and the wider internet in order, then shows which step is failing and the most likely cause. Check one website to see if it's that site or your whole connection. No account, ads or tracking.

What's inside the Lumi Learning Bundle, app by app:

• Lumi Bopomofo Pro: all 37 Zhuyin sounds, blending, the five tones, stroke-order tracing
• Lumi Letters Pro: phonics across 14 planets, with 26 letter friends to collect
• Lumi Math Pro: 46 picture-based question types, every question read aloud
• Lumi Mission Planet Pro: meals, tooth brushing, sleep time, tidy-up and school prep as daily missions

The first three can print worksheets from the Parent Zone. iPhone and iPad only.

「Lumi 知育セット」の4本、保護者ページでできることを並べてみました。

ボポモフォ：学んだ注音・最近まちがえた注音の、なぞり書き＋テストのプリント
レター：その日に練習した文字の「今日のプリント」（PDF）
さんすうプラネット：解答つき20問プリント
ミッション星：プリントではなく、できた時刻を保護者ダッシュボードに記録

4本は App Store でまとめて購入できます。iPhone・iPad 専用です。

Three apps, one trip.

Before you go: TripBee Pro. A day-by-day itinerary everyone you invite can edit, and a packing list built from trip length, season and each family member.
Paperwork: Snapport. Passport, visa and ID photo templates (US 2×2, 35×45mm and more), face guides and print layouts, processed on your iPhone.
On the road: G+Money. Log spending in the local currency and see it in your home currency, offline too with the last saved rate.

All three come in one App Store bundle. iPhone and iPad only.

出発の数週間前：TripBee で旅程を組んで、同行者を招待して一緒に編集。
申請書類の準備：Snapport でパスポート・ビザ用の証明写真。日本の 35×45mm などのテンプレートつき。
旅行中：G+Money で現地通貨のまま記録、自国通貨に換算。

3本は App Store の「海外旅行セット」でまとめて購入できます。iPhone・iPad 専用。

Two ways into a new language.

Words first: Wordmate. 44 languages, 84 units across 14 topics like airport, hotel and asking directions, with spoken pronunciation.
Sentences first: DailyMate. 8,400 everyday phrases in 47 learning languages, each paired with a natural reply.

The Wordmate & DailyMate Bundle gets you both in one purchase. iPhone and iPad only.

語学学習パックの2本、細かいところの違い。

Wordmate：英単語にはすべて例文つき。学習言語ごとに進捗を別々に記録。
DailyMate：各テーマに初級・中級・上級200フレーズずつ。選んだ言語に合うシステム音声で聞けます。

2本は App Store でまとめて購入できます。iPhone・iPad 専用です。

孩子正在學哪一塊，就看哪一款：

注音（37 個注音、拼讀、聲調）→ Lumi 注音星球 Pro
英文自然發音（開頭、中間、結尾音）→ Lumi 字母星球 Pro
數學（46 種看圖題型、全程語音念題）→ Lumi 數學星球
生活常規（吃飯、刷牙、睡覺、收玩具、上學準備）→ Lumi 任務星球 Pro

四款在 App Store 有組合包，一次買齊。限 iPhone／iPad。

行前清單，三個 App 各管一格：

☐ 行程：TripBee 逐日行程，登機證、訂位代號附在當站，一鍵開 Apple 地圖導航
☐ 證件照：Snapport 內建護照、簽證、證件常用尺寸範本，照片在裝置上處理、不上傳
☐ 旅費：G+Money 內建 50 種貨幣，每趟旅程分開記、各自小計

App Store「出國旅遊包」三款一次買齊，限 iPhone／iPad。

選哪一款？

想先累積單字 → Wordmate：44 種語言，14 個主題、84 個單元，分初中高三級
想直接學整句 → DailyMate：47 種學習語言，每個主題初級、中級、高級各 200 句
兩個都要 → App Store「語言學習包」一次買齊

限 iPhone／iPad。
Wi-Fiのアイコンはついているのに、何も開かない。WiFi Aid Lite はワンタップで Wi-Fi、DNS、インターネットを順番にチェックし、どこで止まっているのかと、いちばん可能性の高い原因を表示します。「サイトをチェック」なら、そのサイトだけの問題か回線全体かも切り分けられます。アカウント登録は不要、広告もトラッキングもありません。

An hour of meeting notes and your boss wants one slide? Paste in the text or add a CSV in OnePage PPT, tap Make My Slide, and the key points become headlines, the numbers a chart. It only draws charts your data supports and never invents figures. Runs on your device, no account.

Revising in a noisy flat share? Sereno has steady brown and pink noise generated live on your phone, plus ready-made focus and study scenes. Layer rain or a fan under it, set each volume, save the mix. Fully offline. Free to start; Pro is an in-app purchase.

That spare iPad in the drawer can be a nightstand clock. Stay Clock can stay lit only while it charges, drops to a dim red face on true black at night and shifts pixels to go easy on OLED. One free face is included; an in-app purchase adds 100 more, flip clocks too.
子連れ旅行の荷造り、毎回ゼロから考えていませんか。TripBeeは日数・季節・家族一人ひとり、子どもの年齢に合わせて持ち物リストを自動で作成。天気を見て雨の日の屋内プランも用意しておけます。買い切りの有料アプリで、サブスクはありません。

Belege für die Steuererklärung sammeln, ohne fremde Cloud: ScanTo Pro erkennt den Text auf dem Gerät, sortiert Quittungen und Verträge automatisch und findet jedes Dokument über ein Wort aus dem Inhalt. Kein Konto, kein Tracking. Ein In-App-Kauf schaltet die Vollversion frei.

Multi-city trip with three flights and four hotels? TripBee puts each stop in time order with its own time zone and tickets attached, plus one-tap directions from any starting point. Paid app, one-time purchase, no subscription.
デスクの時計と手首の時計、デザインをそろえたい人へ。Stay Clockは選んだ文字盤をStandBy、ロック画面、ホーム画面ウィジェット、Apple Watchまで同じ見た目で表示。時報とシンプルなアラーム付き。無料の文字盤を1つ収録、アプリ内課金でパタパタ時計を含む100種類を追加できます。 ※StandBy・ロック画面・Apple Watchでの表示はiOS版の機能です。

Scanning a lease or passport page shouldn't mean uploading it. ScanTo Pro has no cloud and no account: OCR runs on your iPhone, Face ID can lock it and it works in airplane mode. Free to start; an in-app purchase unlocks the full version. This describes the iPhone version.

Want a gentler morning? Sereno's sunrise wake-up fades in birdsong at the time you pick while the app stays open, so keep your usual alarm too. Rain, ocean and crickets are real field recordings that reshuffle as you listen, never a fixed loop. This describes the iPhone version.
揪團出國，行程還在群組裡傳來傳去？把原本的試算表用 CSV 匯進 TripBee，受邀的朋友都能一起改同一份逐日行程，排好再做成旅程海報丟回群組。開啟 iCloud 就在你的私人 iCloud 同步，沒有廣告、沒有追蹤。付費 App，一次買斷、免訂閱。※多人共同編輯與 iCloud 同步是 iOS 版的功能。

Need a desk clock you can read across the room? Stay Clock turns an iPhone or iPad into a full-screen one. Each face gets its own calendar, from off to a full month view. Hourly chime and simple alarm. One free face; an in-app purchase adds 100 more.

Team three time zones away? Set Stay Clock to their city and keep it on your desk showing their time. Any time zone, 12 or 24 hour time, instant app language switch. No account, no ads. One free face; an in-app purchase adds 100 more. Time zone picker is iPhone and iPad only.

Need a copy of your ID for a form? ScanTo Pro's ID Card mode puts the front and back on a single page and exports PDFs sized to US Letter, ready to print. No cloud, no account. Free to start; an in-app purchase unlocks the ID-card layout and every advanced export.

No reception on site? ScanTo Pro turns invoices, forms and contracts into sharp PDFs offline. On-device text recognition sorts each scan into Receipts, IDs, Cards and Contracts. Free to start; an in-app purchase unlocks the full version. This describes the iPhone version.

Dissertation due in May? Set a deadline and target in Studydown and see the daily pace you still need. Flip your phone face down to start; pick it up and it pauses, so only real focus time counts. Deadlines, goals and unlimited recording: one-off Pro purchase, no subscription.

鞋都穿好了，外套到底要不要帶？
早上趕出門最常卡在這一題：一家人要穿幾件、傘帶不帶。我是 Lumi天氣星球的開發者，我的做法是把體感溫度、紫外線、降雨和風合成一個 0 到 100 的外出指數，旁邊附一句判斷；點一下指數，每一項怎麼影響分數都看得到。
它會標出今天最適合出門的時段，該帶傘、該戴帽子擦防曬、風大要加件薄外套，都會提醒你；明天可能下雨，也會先說一聲。以上這些加上每日提醒，打開就能用。也可以把 Lumi 放到主畫面當小工具。
完整版在 App 內購買解鎖：逐時頁、一週預報、依天氣列出該穿什麼和該帶什麼的出門準備清單，還有多個常用地點，家裡、公司點一下就切換。不用註冊帳號，沒有廣告，也沒有第三方分析。
